ModMetaData.name: 携带方案 Carry Policy
ModMetaData.author: RunningBugs
ModMetaData.description:
适用于 RimWorld 1.6 的携带策略（Carry Policies）。
可以配置命名的携带策略（类似原版的药物策略），指定殖民者应当在物品栏中随身携带哪些物品。可以在「分配」选项卡中为每名殖民者单独指定策略。
功能：
原版风格的策略管理界面：支持创建、复制、重命名和设置默认策略。左侧为策略列表，右侧为双栏编辑器（携带列表 + 可选择物品），支持按类别浏览、搜索和多选。 任何能够放入殖民者物品栏的物品都可以设置为随身携带：食物、营养膏、牛奶、药物、医疗用品、资源等。 营养膏会直接从营养膏分配机获取（每次获取一份）。 食物数量以份数计算：一份相当于普通成年殖民者一顿饭的食量（0.9 营养值，约可维持 13.5 小时）。饥饿速度更快的殖民者（例如模组种族、基因效果等）会自动按比例携带更多食物。 殖民者会自动补充策略要求的随身物品，并且不会主动丢弃或搬走策略中要求携带的物品。
模组以 MIT 许可证开源发布： https://github.com/lisanhu/rimworld-RimModNotes.git
之前发布过一个ItemPolicy，做的功能也相似，但是那个UI特别简陋，且没有使用物品过滤器，导致小人可以带迫击炮建筑在身上，并在任何位置直接放下（不需要建造时间），因为已经有玩家使用这个携带建筑的功能所以也不方便取消，正好这次使用GLM 5.3写一个新版本发布出来。
Carry policies for RimWorld 1.6.
Configure named carry policies (like vanilla drug policies) that specify which items colonists keep in their inventory. Assign them per colonist in the Assign tab.
Features:
- Vanilla-style policy management dialog: create / duplicate / rename / default policies, left list + right two-column editor (carry list and pickable items with category browsing, search and multi-select). - Anything that can enter a pawn inventory can be carried: meals, nutrient paste, milk, drugs, medicine, resources... - Nutrient paste is fetched from paste dispensers (one meal per trip). - Food amounts are measured in portions: one portion is what an average adult eats in one meal (0.9 nutrition, about 13.5 hours). Pawns with faster hunger (modded races, genes...) automatically carry proportionally more items. - Pawns top up their inventory automatically and never drop or haul away items covered by their policy.
Mod published in MIT license at https://github.com/lisanhu/rimworld-RimModNotes.git
I previously released a mod called ItemPolicy with similar functionality, but its UI was very basic, and it didn’t use proper item filtering. As a result, pawns could carry things like mortar buildings in their inventory and place them down anywhere instantly, without any construction time.
Since some players have already started using this building-carrying behavior as a feature, it would be awkward to remove it from ItemPolicy now. So I took the opportunity to use GLM 5.3 to write a new version and release it separately.
